description: This file appears to be a C header file defining external functions related to processing text input (specifically reading the next field and next line from a file) within the context of the SRP (Secure Remote Password) authentication project. It includes licensing and copyright information, macro definitions for function prototypes, and declarations of external functions.

methods.name: t_nextfield
methods.description: Reads the next field from a file stream into a buffer

methods.name: t_nextline
methods.description: Reads the next line from a file stream
